comparison: d=4: cosine~1 (branch eigenvector essentially frozen through the crossing). d=6: cosine 0.57-0.81 depending on step (0.57 at dd=0.01, 0.81 at dd=0.02) -- NOT close to 1 either way, i.e. the eigenvector rotates substantially through the d=6 crossing. This is a genuine qualitative difference from d=4, not a step-size artifact (smaller step gives LOWER cosine at d=6, opposite of what pure discretisation/continuity would predict).
